reply_text:
Found four issues worth fixing before merge:

1. **Short previews lose text and always get an ellipsis** — `src/excerpt.js:6–8`
   `excerpt('hello world', 30)` returns `"hello…"`, and empty input returns `"…"`. This violates the README’s unchanged-at-or-under-limit contract.
   **Fix:** Return the original text immediately when its length is at most the limit.

2. **A word ending exactly at the limit is dropped** — `src/words.js:2–3`
   `excerpt('hello world again', 11)` returns `"hello…"` instead of `"hello world…"`. The slice excludes the space at index 11, so the helper backs up to the previous space.
   **Fix:** Include the boundary at `limit` when searching for a space.

3. **The helpers never reach the cards** — `src/card.js:2`; `src/excerpt.js:5`; `src/plain.js:1`
   `card()` still returns the full trimmed body; neither new helper has a production caller. Long Markdown bodies therefore remain unshortened and retain their formatting syntax.
   **Fix:** Wire `toPlain()` → `excerpt()` into the card-body path with the intended preview limit, and add a card integration test.

4. **Common Markdown markers remain in plain text** — `src/plain.js:3–5`
   `toPlain('# Heading\n\n> quoted text\n\n- item')` returns `"# Heading > quoted text - item"`, leaving heading, quote, and list syntax visible.
   **Fix:** Handle block syntax before collapsing whitespace, or use a Markdown-to-text parser.

All four existing tests pass; the examples above were checked separately. No files changed.
